screen: Tier-1 alert criteria (Binomial GLM logistic-growth screen):
C1 endpoint:    last week of window >= 1%
C4 persistence: week before the endpoint >= 0.25% (two weeks in a row)
C3 fast enough: GLM slope > 0.173/week (odds doubling < 4 weeks)
C5 clear of noise: slope > 2 x noise-adjusted SE (dispersion from the window's scatter)
pseudo denom:   10,000 (slope and noise-adjusted SE are both inert to this)
Watch: endpoint >= 5% but the week before < 0.25%
growth_advantage: look-back:   2024-11-04 to 2024-12-30 (8 weekly points, Freyja's 56-day rule)
lineages:    mean share > 0.1% over the look-back
s:           exp(5.5 x r) - 1, r = fitted daily logistic growth rate
95% CI:      bootstrap, 1,000 refits, both ends through the same exp step
